defs.def: a measurement of the speed at which sth happens 速度；进度

ex.s: Hospital patients Who see tree branches out their window are likely to recover at a faster rate than patients who see buildings or sky instead.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 能从窗户看到树枝的医院病人康复速度可能比看到建筑物或天空的病人更快。

ex.s: Many instructors continue to teach using traditional lectures, which lead to lower success rates.
ex.t: 许多教师继续使用传统的讲授式教学，导致成功率较低。

ex.s: Declining birth rate is a major problem in many developing regions too, which might cause catastrophic global shortages of work force within a few decades.
ex.t: 出生率下降在许多发展中地区也是一个重大问题，这可能在几十年内导致全球劳动力严重短缺。

ex.s: It has a digital display that records your steps, speed and distance, as well as monitoring your heart rate and calories burnt.
ex.t: 它有一个数字显示屏，记录你的步数、速度和距离，同时监测你的心率和消耗的卡路里。

defs.def: a measurement of the number of times sth happens or exists during a particular period 比率；率

ex.s: A higher class attendance rate.
ex.t: 更高的课堂出勤率。

ex.s: Helping the community lowers rates of depression.
ex.t: 帮助社区能降低抑郁的发生率。

ex.s: To predict their maximum heart rate.
ex.t: 预测他们的最大心率。

ex.s: A big fall in crime rates.
ex.t: 犯罪率大幅下降。

ex.s: Too much workout often slows metabolic rates.
ex.t: 过多运动常常会减慢代谢率。

ex.s: But while increasing health was a typical feature of the 20th century, declining birth rate could be a defining one of the 21st.
ex.t: 但虽然健康水平的提高是20世纪的典型特征，出生率的下降可能是21世纪的一个决定性特征。

ex.s: In a further twist, birth rate is highest in poorly educated rural areas and lowest in highly educated urban areas.
ex.t: 更进一步的是，出生率在教育程度低的农村地区最高，在教育程度高的城市地区最低。

ex.s: But, although the death rate is very high, we will never give up on a patient, and our efforts do sometimes end in miracles.
ex.t: 但是，尽管死亡率很高，我们永远不会放弃一个病人，而我们的努力有时确实会以奇迹告终。

ex.s: In the north of India, the population is booming due to high birth rates, but in the south, where most economic development is taking place, birth rate is falling rapidly.
ex.t: 在印度北部，由于高出生率，人口正在激增，但在大多数经济发展正在进行的南部，出生率正在迅速下降。

defs.def: a fixed amount of money that is charged or paid for sth 价格；费用
(in Britain) a tax paid by businesses to a local authority for land and buildings that they use and in the past also paid by anyone who owned a house （英国地方政府征收的）房地产税，房产税

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．

ex.s: They had slow metabolic rates.
ex.t: 它们的代谢率很慢。

ex.s: When vaccination rates are very high, as they still are in the nation as a whole, everyone is protected.
ex.t: 当接种率非常高时，正如全国整体仍然如此，每个人都能受到保护。

ex.s: The couple has a high   51   rate in getting accepted as house sitters and they always go beyond the homeowner's   52  .
ex.t: 这对夫妇被接受为房屋看护者的   51  率很高，他们总是超越房主的   52  。

ex.s: Data collected from the device could be used to recognize different participants based on how they typed, with very low error rates.
ex.t: 从设备收集的数据可用于根据打字方式识别不同的参与者，错误率很低。

ex.s: “People who live in plant-rich environments report a higher life satisfaction rating, ” she says.
ex.t: “生活在植物丰富环境中的人报告了更高的生活满意度评分，”她说。

defs.def: used to say that a particular fact is true despite what has happened in the past or what may happen in the future （强调事情的真实性）无论如何，不管怎样

ex.s: The target recycling rate in these cities has been set at 55% by 2020.
ex.t: 这些城市的目标回收率被设定为到2020年达到55%。

ex.s: The target recycling rate in these cities has been set at 35% by 2020.
ex.t: 这些城市的目标回收率被设定为到2020年达到35%。

defs.def: used to show that you are being more accurate about sth that you have just said （表示说得更加确切）不管怎样，至少

ex.s: Interestingly，the more cheerful the music was，the faster their heart rates were．
ex.t: 有趣的是音乐越欢快他们的心率越快。

ex.s: The average death rate of those infected is about 50%.
ex.t: 感染者的平均死亡率约为50%。

ex.s: In Australia we now have over twenty million cars for just over twenty-six million people, among the highest rate of car ownership in the world.
ex.t: 在澳大利亚，我们现在有超过两千万辆车对应刚过两千六百万人口，是世界上汽车拥有率最高的国家之一。

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.
ex.t: 此外，约50%的世界人口生活在生育率目前低于替代水平（即每名女性2.1个孩子）的地区，几乎所有发达国家都在经历低于替代水平的生育率。

defs.def: used to show that what you have just said is not as important as what you are going to say （强调下文）总而言之，反正

ex.s: The first is declining birth rates, which means old generations are large   60   （compare） to younger generations, and so, on average, the population becomes   61   （old） than before.
ex.t: 首先是出生率的下降，这意味着老一代比年轻一代____60____（庞大），因此平均而言人口变得比以前____61____（老）。

defs.def: to have or think that sb/sth has a particular level of quality, value, etc. 评估；评价；估价

ex.s: We found that those rated as more moral reported a stronger sense of well-being.
ex.t: 我们发现，那些被评价为更正直的人报告了更强的幸福感。

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在她的研究中，Martin让参与者评价他们对男性、女性以及无性别版本的数字语音助手和名为“Miuu”的自动驾驶汽车的依恋程度。研究发现，性别增强了用户对这些设备的依恋感以及购买兴趣。

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分成两组：“美感”组被要求主动思考并评价每件所见物品的美，而对照组只是把物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: That movie led him into the second half of his career where his comedic presence alone could make a movie a financial success even when movie reviewers would not rate it highly.
ex.t: 那部电影让他进入了职业生涯的后半段，那时仅凭他的喜剧存在感就能让一部电影取得票房成功，即使影评人不会给它高评价。

defs.def: to think that sb/sth is good 认为 … 是好的；看好
to place sb/sth in a particular position on a scale in relation to similar people or things 划分等级；分等

ex.s: Give each piece a rating.
ex.t: 给每件作品打分。

defs.def: to be good, important, etc. enough to be treated in a particular way 值得，配得上（某种对待）
to state that a film/movie or video is suitable for a particular audience 对（电影或录像片）分级
